content_html:
Cusco is a paradise for motorcycle lovers, with roads that cross mountains, valleys and otherworldly landscapes. If you are looking for adrenaline and connection with nature, these routes will take you to unique destinations, from the famous 7 Colors Mountain to less explored routes with spectacular views.

1. Cusco – Mountain of 7 Colors by Motorcycle

  • Distance: 140 km (round trip)
  • Estimated time: 6-7 hours
  • Difficulty: High (height and demanding roads)

Route description

The adventure begins in Cusco and follows the highway south, passing through Urcos and Checacupe. Then, you take a detour along a dirt road that runs through high mountain landscapes. As you climb, the air becomes colder and the colors of the land begin to change.

Getting to the closest point to the Mountain of 7 Colors by motorcycle is an incredible experience. From there, you must walk a few kilometers to reach the top and admire the impressive natural rainbow of the Andes.

Tips:

  • Wear warm clothing, since the altitude exceeds 5,000 meters above sea level.
  • Use a dual-purpose or enduro motorcycle, since the road is partly dirt road.
  • Carry enough gasoline, since there are no taps in the final section.

If you do not want to do it with your own hands and resources you can always hire climbing the mountain on a quad bike.

2. Cusco – Humantay Lagoon by Motorcycle

  • Distance: 250 km (round trip)
  • Estimated time: 8-9 hours
  • Difficulty: Medium-High

Route description

From Cusco, you take the road to Mollepata, where the spectacular views of the mountain range begin. Then, you continue along a trail road to Soraypampa. From there, the motorcycle reaches the base, but the last section is done on foot.

Humantay Lagoon is one of the most beautiful in the Andes, with turquoise waters surrounded by snow-capped mountains.

If you do not want to do it with your own hands and resources you can always hire a private tour.

Tips:

  • The best season for this route is between May and September (less rain).
  • Bring rain gear if you travel in the wet season.
  • Consider acclimatizing before the trip, as altitude can affect you.

3. Cusco – Three Golden Crosses (Manu National Park)

  • Distance: 110 km
  • Estimated time: 4-5 hours
  • Difficulty: Medium-High

Route description

This route takes you to one of the most impressive viewpoints in Peru. From Cusco, you travel to Paucartambo and then continue along a road that crosses the Andes and descends into the Manu jungle.

The sunrise at Tres Cruces de Oro is unique in the world: during certain times of the year, the sun appears to "double" due to a natural optical effect.

If you do not want to do it with your own hands and resources you can always hire a private tour.

4. Cusco – Maras – Moray – Salineras by Motorcycle

  • Distance: 90 km (round trip)
  • Estimated time: 3-4 hours
  • Difficulty: Low-Medium

Route description

This route is perfect for those looking for a short adventure, but full of history and impressive landscapes. From Cusco, you take the road to the Sacred Valley and turn off towards Maras.

By motorcycle, you can travel the dirt roads that connect the circular platforms of Moray with the famous Salineras de Maras. There are more than 3,000 white salt pools on the side of a mountain, an incredible visual spectacle.

If you do not want to do it with your own hands and resources you can always hire a private tour.
